games.title: Meaning Match
games.description: Match each unit word to its child-friendly meaning.

rounds.prompt: Which word means a person you work or play with?
rounds.explanation: A partner is a person you work or play with.

rounds.prompt: Which word means a chart that shows days, weeks and months?
rounds.explanation: A calendar helps us find days, weeks, months and dates.

rounds.prompt: Which word means the day each year when you celebrate being born?
rounds.explanation: Your birthday comes once each year.

rounds.prompt: Which word means a group of seven days?
rounds.explanation: A week is a group of seven days that follow one after another.

rounds.prompt: Which word means one of the twelve parts of a year?
rounds.explanation: A month is one of the twelve parts of a year.

rounds.prompt: Which word means the part of the day between midday and evening?
rounds.explanation: The afternoon is the part of the day between midday and evening.

games.title: Spelling Builder
games.description: Choose letter tiles to build important unit words.

rounds.prompt: Build the greeting word.
rounds.clue: You say it when you meet someone.

rounds.prompt: Build the friendship word.
rounds.clue: A person you know and like.

rounds.prompt: Build the calendar word.
rounds.clue: It shows days, weeks and months.

rounds.prompt: Build the time word.
rounds.clue: A group of seven days that follow one after another.

rounds.prompt: Build the family word.
rounds.clue: The sister of your mother or father.

rounds.prompt: Build the outdoor word.
rounds.clue: What it is like outside, such as sunny, rainy or windy.

games.title: Sentence Puzzle
games.description: Put the words in order to make a complete sentence.

rounds.prompt: Introduce Amal.
Tell what she enjoys.
Ask a complete colour question.
Say when your birthday is.
Tell the class about Nora.
Say what your class does each week.
rounds.answer: We read a book every week.

games.title: Grammar Sort
games.description: Choose the form that makes each sentence correct.

rounds.prompt: This is Amal. ___ likes reading.
rounds.explanation: Use she when talking about one girl or woman.

rounds.prompt: Leo ___ football.
rounds.explanation: Use likes with he, she or one named person.

rounds.prompt: Choose the complete question.
rounds.explanation: The complete pattern is: What colour is ...?

rounds.prompt: Nora and Leo ___ in the same class.
rounds.explanation: Use are when you are talking about more than one person.

rounds.prompt: This is my aunt. ___ visits us every month.
rounds.explanation: Use she when talking about one girl or woman.

rounds.prompt: Amal ___ her book on the desk.
rounds.explanation: Use puts with he, she or one named person.

games.title: Reading Detective
games.description: Use evidence from Amal's First Week to solve each clue.
games.passage: Amal met Leo on Saturday. Leo became her first partner. He likes football and mangoes, and his birthday is in June. On Thursday, Amal welcomed Nora and offered to be her partner.

rounds.prompt: Who was Amal's first partner?
rounds.explanation: The story says that Leo offered to be Amal's partner.

rounds.prompt: When is Leo's birthday?
rounds.explanation: Leo says that his birthday is in June.

rounds.prompt: How did Amal help Nora?
rounds.explanation: Amal smiled, introduced herself and offered to be Nora's partner.

rounds.prompt: How does Amal spell her name for Teacher Yasmin?
rounds.explanation: Amal says the letters A-M-A-L.

rounds.prompt: Who is Maya's partner, and what does that partner like?
choices: Teacher Yasmin, and she likes books.
rounds.explanation: Maya's partner is Nora, and Nora likes trees.

rounds.prompt: Which day is the first day of the school week in this story?
rounds.explanation: The story says Saturday is the first day of the school week.

games.title: Speaking Quest
games.description: Listen, record, review and submit three useful sentences.

rounds.prompt: Introduce yourself and say what you like.
rounds.target: My name is Amal. I like reading.

rounds.prompt: Talk about a birthday month.
Welcome a new friend.
rounds.target: Hello. You can be my partner.

rounds.prompt: Say hello to your teacher.
Introduce a friend to the class.
Say two things you like.

games.title: Calendar Race
games.description: Put days and months into the correct order before time runs out.

rounds.prompt: Put these school-week days in order.
Put these middle-week days in order.
Put these months in calendar order.
Put these end-of-week days in order.
Put these middle-year months in order.
Put these end-of-year months in order.

games.title: Colour and Number Dash
games.description: Choose the correct colour or number word in each fast challenge.

rounds.prompt: Which word names the colour of grass?
rounds.explanation: Grass is commonly described as green.

rounds.prompt: Which number comes after eleven?
rounds.explanation: The counting order ends this unit with eleven, twelve.

rounds.prompt: Which spelling names the colour of the sky on a clear day?
rounds.explanation: Blue is the colour word.

rounds.prompt: Which word names the colour of a ripe banana?
rounds.explanation: A ripe banana is yellow.

rounds.prompt: Which number comes after nine?
rounds.explanation: The counting order goes nine, ten, eleven, twelve.

rounds.prompt: Which word names the colour of fresh milk?
rounds.explanation: Fresh milk is white.

games.title: Pronoun Power
games.description: Choose he or she to introduce each person clearly.

rounds.prompt: This is Maya. ___ likes trees.
rounds.explanation: Use she for Maya in this unit dialogue.

rounds.prompt: This is Leo. ___ likes football.
rounds.explanation: Use he for Leo in the story.

rounds.prompt: This is Teacher Yasmin. ___ welcomes Amal.
rounds.explanation: The story uses she for Teacher Yasmin.

rounds.prompt: This is my desk. ___ is next to the window.
rounds.explanation: Use it for a thing, not for a person.

rounds.prompt: These are my friends. ___ like football.
rounds.explanation: Use they when you are talking about more than one person.

rounds.prompt: This is my father. ___ helps me read.
rounds.explanation: Use he when talking about one boy or man.

games.description: Turn over tiles and connect each word with its matching meaning.

rounds.prompt: Match the greeting words.
pairs: a person you know and like

rounds.prompt: Match the calendar words.

rounds.prompt: Match the room words.

a table you sit at to read and write

rounds.prompt: Match the family words.
pairs: a woman who has a child
a man who has a child

games.title: Question Quest
games.description: Arrange words to build complete questions for a partner.

rounds.prompt: Ask for a person's name.
Ask how to spell a name.
Ask what someone likes.
Ask someone's age.
Ask about a birthday.
Ask about today.

games.title: Welcome Mission
games.description: Choose the best response to help a new classmate feel welcome.

rounds.prompt: A new learner is standing by the door. What should you say first?
rounds.explanation: A friendly greeting helps a new learner feel welcome.

rounds.prompt: The learner tells you her name. What is a kind next response?
rounds.explanation: Offering to be a partner shows kindness and inclusion.

rounds.prompt: Your new partner says, 'I like drawing.' What should you say?
rounds.explanation: A relevant, friendly response keeps the dialogue going.

rounds.prompt: Your new partner cannot find a pencil. What should you say?
rounds.explanation: Sharing a pencil helps a new partner feel welcome.

rounds.prompt: A friend says, 'My birthday is in May.' What is a kind reply?
rounds.explanation: A warm reply keeps the conversation friendly.

rounds.prompt: It is the end of the school day. What do you say to your partner?
rounds.explanation: Goodbye is what we say when we leave.
